name: Organic Heirloom Rainbow Tomatoes
harvestNote: Harvested fresh at dawn while still cool from the morning mist.
storageTip: Store at room temperature out of direct sunlight. Do not refrigerate to preserve natural aromatic sweetness.
description: Prized multi-colored heirloom varieties (Cherokee Purple, Brandywine, Green Zebra) grown on open compost beds. Incomparable rich, smoky, and complex natural flavor.

name: Crisp Honeycrisp Apples
harvestNote: Tree-ripened on high trellis rows, hand-picked for peak sugar-to-acid ratio.
storageTip: Keep refrigerated in the crisper drawer to maintain satisfying explosive crunch for up to 4 weeks.
description: Extra crisp, explosive honey-sweet crunch with a bright tart finish. Hand-selected for uniform size and flawless unblemished skin.

name: Raw Wildflower Honey Comb Jar
harvestNote: Extracted without heat treatment, retaining active bee enzymes, pollen, and natural beeswax comb slice.
storageTip: Store sealed at room temperature. Natural crystallization is normal; gently warm jar in warm water if needed.
description: Pure single-source wildflower nectar harvested from protected native Illinois prairie preserves. Rich golden color with hints of clover, lavender, and basswood blossoms.

name: Pastured Free-Range Brown Eggs
harvestNote: Gathered fresh each morning from portable hen houses moved across organic pastures.
storageTip: Keep refrigerated at 35-40°F. Thick albumen and deep orange marigold yolks guarantee maximum nutrient density.
description: Deep orange yolks with rich flavor from Heritage Rhode Island Red hens foraged naturally on green clover, herbs, and sunshine.

name: Wood-Fired Sourdough Country Loaf
harvestNote: Hand-shaped and baked on stone hearth floors in a wood-fired brick oven.
storageTip: Store cut-side down on a wooden cutting board for 3 days, or freeze sliced in airtight bag.
description: Traditional naturally leavened sourdough with a deep blistered dark golden crust and an airy, custardy open crumb. Baked using locally milled organic heirloom wheat.

name: Hydroponic Crisp Baby Spinach
harvestNote: Harvested young at peak leaf tenderness, gently spun and hydro-cooled.
storageTip: Keep in original breathable produce bag in the crisper; use within 7 days.
description: Ultra-tender, nutrient-rich emerald baby spinach leaves grown in purified mineral spring water. Sweet, never bitter, ideal for raw salads and sautéing.

name: Sweet Heirloom Rainbow Carrots
harvestNote: Field-dug by hand with lush green tops attached.
storageTip: Remove green tops before storing to prevent moisture loss; keep root in a sealed container.
description: A radiant rainbow bunch of purple, yellow, white, and deep orange heirloom carrots with intense earthy sweetness.

name: Heritage Yellow Freestone Peaches
harvestNote: Picked mature when fruit softens to gentle thumb pressure.
storageTip: Leave at room temperature until fragrant and fully soft, then refrigerate.
description: Velvety skin with intense floral perfume and bursting sweet juice. Freestone flesh separates cleanly from the pit.

name: Sweet Organic Red Strawberries
harvestNote: Picked at ruby red ripeness, never ripened in transit with artificial gases.
storageTip: Do not wash until immediately before eating. Store dry in original ventilated pint.
description: Deep red to the core, packed with genuine wild strawberry aroma and concentrated summer sweetness.

name: Artisan Goat Cheese Log with Fresh Herbs
harvestNote: Slow-drained curd rolled by hand in fresh rosemary, thyme, and cracked black pepper.
storageTip: Wrap tightly in cheese paper or wax paper; consume within 14 days of opening.
description: Creamy, tangy, spreadable chèvre hand-rolled in garden thyme and dried lavender blossoms. Produced from pastured Saanen goats.

name: Pure Grass-Fed Whole Milk (Half Gallon)
harvestNote: Low-temperature vat pasteurized to protect beneficial enzymes and creamline top.
storageTip: Shake gently to disperse natural golden cream cap. Keep refrigerated below 38°F.
description: Old-fashioned non-homogenized cream-top milk from 100% pasture-fed Jersey cows. Rich, velvety, and naturally sweet.

name: Spiced Cinnamon Apple Brioche
harvestNote: Filled with diced orchard apples simmered with Ceylon cinnamon and brown sugar.
storageTip: Best enjoyed day of purchase. Gently warm in toaster oven at 300°F for 3 minutes.
description: Buttery, flaky laminated brioche pastry folded around caramelized Honeycrisp apple compote and spiced cinnamon glaze.

name: Multi-Seed Artisan Sourdough Baguette
harvestNote: Coated with toasted flax, sesame, poppy seeds, and cracked sunflower kernels.
storageTip: Do not refrigerate. Wrap in a clean cloth; refresh crust with 5 mins in oven.
description: Crunchy seeded crust giving way to an aerated crumb with a pleasant nutty chew and sourdough tang.

name: Cold-Pressed Extra Virgin Sunflower Oil
harvestNote: Single cold-pressed without chemical solvents, preserving natural vitamin E and nutty aroma.
storageTip: Keep in a cool dark pantry away from stovetop heat to prevent oxidation.
description: Golden, fragrant cold-pressed oil with a delicate buttery sunflower seed taste. Ideal for fresh salad vinaigrettes and dipping.

name: Raw Apple Cider Vinegar with Mother
harvestNote: Naturally fermented from 100% whole heirloom apple juice, containing the active probiotic 'mother'.
storageTip: Store at room temperature indefinitely. Shake well before pouring.
description: Rich amber vinegar boasting zesty acidity balanced by mellow apple sweetness and living probiotic cultures.

name: Sweet Sugar Snap Peas
harvestNote: Plump juicy pods harvested while dew still clings to the vines.
storageTip: Refrigerate in produce drawer; eat raw or lightly steam within 5 days.
description: Super crisp, juicy, sweet edible pods bursting with early-morning hydration. Delicious raw as a snack or in stir-fries.
